records.title: Promotion of Underground Coal Mining in the Country
details: It was inter-alia stated that the Ministry of Coal has envisaged to enhance UG coal production from the current level of production of about 34.33 MT during FY 2023-24 to the level of 100 MT (Million Tonne) by FY 2030.
